about: David M. Beller is an attorney who represents clients in the Denver, Colorado area. David Beller is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2017 - 2027. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

David Beller chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended The University of Toledo College of Law and graduated in 2004. David Beller passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2004.
He represents clients with Criminal Defense issues in Colorado. He also represents clients with Criminal Defense: White Collar, Professional Liability: Defense and Criminal Defense: DUI / DWI issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, David Beller has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
